Danielle Poirier, Orenk A ssociates

26 September

Mina Khan

President, Exercise Wave Gyms
28 Gloucester Street

Liverpool L27 1XQ

Dear Ms. Khan,

It was a pleasure to review your company's Web site. Visually speaking, your site is
just as appealing as those of your top competitors. I particularly liked your
selection of photos.

However, your marketing message appears to lack focus throughout the site-
sometimes you emphasize the facilities, sometimes the customer service, and
sometimes the low fees. I have some ideas for new site content that would help you
communicate to your potential customers more clearly and engagingly.

I would like to meet with you to discuss my review in greater detail. I would also
like to share with you a social-media strategy that would increase your brand
recognition. If you think you might benefit from my services, please let me know
when you are available.

I look forward to hearing from you.
Best regards,
Danielle Poirier

Danielle Poirier
